data: What is the value of the BLI for the orange dashed line when the source window size is 10, for the target window size 10?

The question asks for the value of the BLI for the orange dashed line when the source window size is 10 and the target window size is 10. From the caption, we know that the target window size is fixed at 10, so we need to look at the rightmost graph in the compound figure, which corresponds to target window size 10.

In this graph, the orange dashed line represents the de language. We can see that when the source window size is approximately 10, the orange dashed line (de) is around 0.35 on the y-axis, which represents the BLI (mrr). Therefore, the value of the BLI for the orange dashed line when the source window size is 10 and the target window size is 10 is approximately 0.35.
